silhouette.reason: Measured USGS 3DEP relief: Half Dome central and highest, sheer north-rim walls over a flat glacial floor; reads as Yosemite's east end from the Glacier Point direction.
fixes: z14 tiles to sharpen Half Dome's NW face lip (stepped at 15.6 m spacing)

proportions.reason: True scale 4 × 4 km; Half Dome summit 1 524.8 m above datum vs 1 525 m from Wikidata (−0.01 %); Glacier Point within 0.9 % of Wikidata.
fixes: a true-relief view from Glacier Point's own position (an interior camera) to compare the photo silhouette 1:1

materials.reason: Strips per triangle by slope and altitude (cliff, gravel, moss); granite domes' 30–45° bare backs read partly as forest; LOD2 shows diagonal banding in the moss/grass strips.
fixes: land cover from an open dataset instead of slope-only colouring

detail.reason: Survey detail only (talus cones, gullies, benches at 15.6 m); no trees, boulders or river.
fixes: scatter tree impostors on the forest floor
carve the Merced from an OSM centreline

wear.reason: No weathering beyond what the terrain shape carries; no water streaks on the granite.
fixes: dark water streaks down the cliff strip below drainage lines

lod.reason: 256/128/64 cells from one grid; LOD2 silhouette IoU ≥ 0.99; small dark slivers on LOD2 ridgelines.
fixes: drop or seat the dark slivers on LOD2 ridgelines (strip seams at coarse cells)

technical.reason: One part, one draw call, 133k/34k/8.7k triangles, byte-deterministic, DEM hash verified on decode, credit in the GLB copyright.
fixes: a 512-cell z14 variant for hero use with the 256 grid kept for games
